name: Raschke 80-20: momentum-candle close overshoot 20 points and return, 50% target
author: Linda Bradford Raschke (via RoboForex education article)
license: Source terms apply; paraphrased summary only
instruments_timeframes: D1 signal, H1 entry; US500 and FX examples.
indicators: Daily candle body/range ratio; H1 entry
entry_long: Signal candle (D1): body >= 80% of its high-low range (shadows <= 20%). In the next days, when price overshoots the momentum candle close by >= 20 points and then returns inside (back through that close), enter in the reversal direction (buy after downside overshoot, sell after upside overshoot) on H1.
entry_short: Mirror: price exceeds the momentum-candle close upward by >= 20 points then returns -> sell stop.
exit: Take profit at 50% of the momentum candle length (center of the candle); if not hit, close manually at end of session (e.g., 23:59). Signal valid for one day only.
stop_loss: Beyond the extreme reached by the false move (above the maximum at trigger for shorts).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Point offset (20) is instrument-specific; convert to ATR or percent for crypto. Version differs from some other descriptions of Raschke 80-20 (open/close in 20%/80% zones); this record follows the RoboForex page only.
